results.title: Boyslut
results.overview: A boyslut confronts the complexities of his identity through an intimate encounter with an older man.

results.title: Hoy no es siempre
results.overview: The countdown against her body has begun. Despite fatigue and coordination problems, she refuses to give up her passion. Her husband, Igor, watches Diana's progress with concern and tries to make her understand the importance of dealing with the disease and making changes in her life. Terrified, feeling guilty and unable to accept her new reality, she ignores all the hands reaching out to help her and makes a superhuman effort to remain independent.

results.title: Love of an Icon: The Legend of Crocodile Dundee
results.original_title: Love of an Icon: The Legend of Crocodile Dundee
results.overview: Nearly 40 years on, Crocodile Dundee remains Australia’s biggest film—what made it a cultural icon, and why does it still mean so much today?

results.title: Nevermore: The Raven Effect
results.overview: A deep dive into the mind of Raven — wrestling's tortured genius- Nevermore explores how one man's pain, brilliance, and chaos helped reshape pro wrestling in ECW's brutal, blood-soaked heyday.

results.title: O Mediador
results.overview: The Mediator tries to remain impartial while filming people calling for a coup d'état in Brazil.

results.title: Telusu Kada
results.overview: A couple's struggle with infertility takes a complicated turn when an ex-partner offers to be their surrogate.

results.title: Twixmas
results.overview: During the hazy, timeless week between Christmas and New Year's, two strangers who just matched on Tinder accidentally run into each other in Central Park, turning a digital connection into a real-life romance.

results.title: Carrousel
results.overview: A group of friends reunite. Their hangout evokes feelings of self doubt and toxic masculine traits - the night spirals out of control

results.title: Don’t Cry, Butterfly
results.overview: After discovering her husband’s affair on live television, a wedding venue worker seeks a powerful spell master to win back his love, while her daughter dreams of a brighter future abroad and a mysterious spirit haunts their crumbling home.

results.title: Mother Company
results.overview: Blending verbatim performance and choral music, Mother Company follows a children’s choir amidst an abandoned power plant in Northern Greece, role-playing as generations of workers of this de-industrialised area. A chorus of young voices reflects on environmental catastrophe, public health and economic depravation while a ‘Green Future’ is promised to save them.

results.title: Sublime
results.overview: Jack awakens one day and begins to realize that a new drink has swept through his town and the people around him are acting strange. Little by little the truth begins to show itself.

results.title: Beyond The Rails
results.overview: Başak is a middle-aged, single, successful but obsessive woman. She could not overcome the cancer she had been battling for years and decides to kill herself. It is August and that global warming has taken the whole world by storm she waits for the train that will take her to her death between the rails. Başak sees tortoises between the rails and learns that farmers throw tortoises between the rails to die in the sun. The train that will take her to death never comes.

results.title: Making Wicked: For Good
results.overview: Return to Oz for a fantastic behind-the-scenes journey with this expansive look inside the characters, choreography, and creativity that make up the movie's unforgettable world.

results.title: Secrets in the Sisterhood
results.overview: When a sorority president is murdered before rush week, her two Littles- Brianna and Chrissy- compete in an election to become her successor, but find themselves counting more than just votes as bodies pile up around them.

results.title: Rispondimi - One last goodbye
results.overview: Ondine lost her Corsican grandmother when she was a child. Since then, the memory has faded. Through a memory quest combining cooking recipes and artificial intelligence, Ondine sets out in the footsteps of her ancestor, bringing her "digitally back to life" through a few rare photos that remain. A posthumous goodbye that could not have taken place.
